title: Contracting the Remember My Name soundtrack and record
summary: Hall lists the band and notes he hopes to be credited as musical coordinator.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Record labels, producers and the business of making albums

blocks.x: Yeah. Now, John Hammond became involved again also in this -- in your last episode at the Cookery, didn't he?
Yes. John is a producer of this record and picture, I guess. The picture, I haven't seen the credits yet on the picture.
Uh-huh. But he called you to do the contracting for the record then?
Now, who was on the record? How many pieces did you use?
Doc Cheatham, Budd Johnson, Vic Dickinson, Connie Kay, Wally Richardson, and on another date, Jackie Williams. That was the group.
And as you said, it was the same music for the record as for the sound track.
Yes. Well, we made an album.
Yeah. You don't know what they're going to --
So I don't know what they're using in the picture.
Right. And you also don't know what kind of credit you're getting in the picture.
No, I don't know. I'm supposed to be the musical coordinator. I asked for that, and I was promised that, so I don't know whether it happened or not.
